<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_data_broker_transform"><sys_ux_data_broker_transform action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><acl_failure_result/><api_name>x_snc_campus360.Campus360 - Student Dashboard Data</api_name><batch_exclude>false</batch_exclude><description/><mutates_server_data>false</mutates_server_data><name>Campus360 - Student Dashboard Data</name><output_schema>{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "found": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "student_sys_id": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "student_id": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "student_name": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "email": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "readiness_score": {
      "type": "number"
    },
    "risk_level": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "primary_skill_gap": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "skill_gap_summary": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "participation_score": {
      "type": "number"
    },
    "missed_opportunities": {
      "type": "number"
    },
    "intervention_count": {
      "type": "number"
    },
    "active_interventions": {
      "type": "number"
    },
    "training_count": {
      "type": "number"
    },
    "placement_status": {
      "type": "string"
    }
  }
}</output_schema><private>false</private><props/><required_translations/><schema_version>1.0.0</schema_version><script><![CDATA[function transform(input) {

    var result = {
        found: false,
        student_sys_id: "",
        student_id: "",
        student_name: "",
        email: "",
        readiness_score: 0,
        risk_level: "",
        primary_skill_gap: "",
        skill_gap_summary: "",
        participation_score: 0,
        missed_opportunities: 0,
        intervention_count: 0,
        active_interventions: 0,
        training_count: 0,
        placement_status: ""
    };

    // --------------------------------------------------
    // 1. Get the currently logged-in ServiceNow user
    // --------------------------------------------------
    var userId = gs.getUserID();

    if (!userId) {
        return result;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------
    // 2. Get the logged-in user's email
    // --------------------------------------------------
    var userGR = new GlideRecord('sys_user');

    if (!userGR.get(userId)) {
        return result;
    }

    var userEmail = userGR.getValue('email');

    if (!userEmail) {
        return result;
    }

    result.email = userEmail;

    // --------------------------------------------------
    // 3. Find the Student Master record by email
    // --------------------------------------------------
    var studentGR = new GlideRecord('x_snc_campus360_student_master');
    studentGR.addQuery('email', userEmail);
    studentGR.setLimit(1);
    studentGR.query();

    if (!studentGR.next()) {
        return result;
    }

    result.found = true;
    result.student_sys_id = studentGR.getUniqueValue();
    result.student_id = studentGR.getValue('student_id') || "";
    result.student_name = studentGR.getValue('student_name') || "";
    result.placement_status = studentGR.getValue('placement_status') || "";

    // --------------------------------------------------
    // 4. Find Placement Intelligence
    // --------------------------------------------------
    var intelligenceGR = new GlideRecord(
        'x_snc_campus360_placement_intelligence'
    );

    intelligenceGR.addQuery('student', studentGR.getUniqueValue());
    intelligenceGR.orderByDesc('last_updated');
    intelligenceGR.setLimit(1);
    intelligenceGR.query();

    if (intelligenceGR.next()) {

        result.readiness_score =
            parseInt(intelligenceGR.getValue('readiness_score'), 10) || 0;

        result.risk_level =
            intelligenceGR.getDisplayValue('risk_level') || "";

        result.primary_skill_gap =
            intelligenceGR.getDisplayValue('primary_skill_gap') || "";

        result.skill_gap_summary =
            intelligenceGR.getValue('skill_gap_summary') || "";

        result.participation_score =
            parseInt(intelligenceGR.getValue('participation_score'), 10) || 0;

        result.missed_opportunities =
            parseInt(intelligenceGR.getValue('missed_opportunities'), 10) || 0;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------
    // 5. Count Placement Interventions
    // --------------------------------------------------
    var interventionGR = new GlideRecord(
        'x_snc_campus360_placement_intervention'
    );

    interventionGR.addQuery('student', studentGR.getUniqueValue());
    interventionGR.query();

    while (interventionGR.next()) {

        result.intervention_count++;

        var status = interventionGR.getValue('status');

        if (
            status != 'completed' &&
            status != 'cancelled' &&
            status != 'failed'
        ) {
            result.active_interventions++;
        }

        if (interventionGR.getValue('training')) {
            result.training_count++;
        }
    }

    return result;
}]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_ux_data_broker_transform</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-20 09:50:09</sys_created_on><sys_id>c1e59f7b9d9f03107f4456802862a719</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Campus360 - Student Dashboard Data</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Campus360" source="x_snc_campus360">7cd68adee41703107f44d305db800ec3</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Campus360">7cd68adee41703107f44d305db800ec3</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_data_broker_transform_c1e59f7b9d9f03107f4456802862a719</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-20 09:50:09</sys_updated_on></sys_ux_data_broker_transform><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=c1e59f7b9d9f03107f4456802862a719"/></record_update>
